description: The verification outcome of each document in the contract's order (typ, alg, manifest not expired, kid in the root-verified manifest with purpose entitlement, signature, schema id, issuer, audience, closed schema, instance, subject, iat/nbf, seq), and of each key manifest body in the manifest order (the published schema and usable keys, then the compact JWS, typ, alg, root, signature, payload, issuer, iat, exp, keys_sha256).

invalid/extra-claim.jws.reason: a claim outside the closed schema

invalid/instance-with-link-member.jws.reason: an instance document carries no link member (the schema's if/then on sub)

invalid/link-names-another-link.jws.reason: a link document whose tenant_link_id is not the link of its sub

invalid/manifest-expired.jws.reason: verified after the manifest's exp: keys of an expired manifest verify no new document

invalid/seq-beyond-i-json.jws.reason: an integer above 2^53 - 1, the schema's maximum

invalid/signature-empty.jws.reason: a canonical but empty signature part: the signature check fails

invalid/signature-padded.jws.reason: the signature part carries base64 padding

invalid/signature-standard-alphabet.jws.reason: the signature part uses the standard base64 alphabet

invalid/signature-stray-bits.jws.reason: the signature part ends in non-zero padding bits (not canonical base64url)

invalid/stale-seq.jws.reason: a lower seq than the cached document's

invalid/tampered-kid.jws.reason: the header names another trusted entitlement key; the first one signed

invalid/wrong-issuer.jws.reason: another issuer than the manifest's and the expected one

invalid/wrong-subject.jws.reason: a link document where the instance document is expected

keys/invalid/time-date-only.json.reason: a key time without a time of day

keys/invalid/time-expanded-year.json.reason: a key time with an expanded year

keys/invalid/time-february-31.json.reason: a key time naming a day that does not exist

keys/invalid/time-garbage-not-after.json.reason: a not_after that is not a time

keys/invalid/time-leap-second.json.reason: a key time on a leap second

keys/invalid/time-lower-case-z.json.reason: a key time ending in a lower-case z

keys/invalid/time-offset.json.reason: a key time with an offset instead of Z

keys/invalid/time-space.json.reason: a key time with a space instead of T

keys/invalid/weak-key.json.reason: a key of small order (the identity point): every signature under it would verify

keys/invalid/weak-root.json.reason: the valid manifest against a root of small order (the identity point)
